rules.name: DepthCut camera moved: calibration stale
rules.query: ( max by (environment, machine) (max_over_time({component="depthcut", environment=~"production|alert-proof", event_name="", migration_copy!~".+"} |= "dynamic_calibration_event=" |= "\"step\":\"calibration_trust\"" |= "\"status\":\"stale\"" | regexp "\"unix_ms\":(?P<unix_ms>[0-9]+)" | keep environment, machine, unix_ms | unwrap unix_ms | __error__="" [24h])) > max by (environment, machine) (max_over_time({component="depthcut", environment=~"production|alert-proof", event_name="", migration_copy!~".+"} |= "dynamic_calibration_event=" |= "\"step\":\"calibration_trust\"" |= "\"status\":\"ok\"" | regexp "\"unix_ms\":(?P<unix_ms>[0-9]+)" | keep environment, machine, unix_ms | unwrap unix_ms | __error__="" [24h])) ) or ( max by (environment, machine) (max_over_time({component="depthcut", environment=~"production|alert-proof", event_name="", migration_copy!~".+"} |= "dynamic_calibration_event=" |= "\"step\":\"calibration_trust\"" |= "\"status\":\"stale\"" | regexp "\"unix_ms\":(?P<unix_ms>[0-9]+)" | keep environment, machine, unix_ms | unwrap unix_ms | __error__="" [24h])) unless max by (environment, machine) (max_over_time({component="depthcut", environment=~"production|alert-proof", event_name="", migration_copy!~".+"} |= "dynamic_calibration_event=" |= "\"step\":\"calibration_trust\"" |= "\"status\":\"ok\"" | regexp "\"unix_ms\":(?P<unix_ms>[0-9]+)" | keep environment, machine, unix_ms | unwrap unix_ms | __error__="" [24h])) )

annotations.description: DepthCut on {{ $labels.machine }} ({{ $labels.environment }}) marked its calibration stale_camera_moved and no repaired calibration has verified since. DepthCut repairs itself (stage 1 re-aim bridge, stage 2 person-free recalibration at the next empty window); this resolves when a replacement verifies against the camera. Evidence: Fiumba Cabinet Runtime > "Camera move: stale / repair evidence". If it stays firing for more than ~30 min with the bed empty, recalibrate by hand.
annotations.summary: {{ $labels.machine }}: camera moved, DepthCut calibration is stale

rules.name: DepthCut camera moved: running on re-aim bridge
rules.query: ( max by (environment, machine) (max_over_time({component="depthcut", environment=~"production|alert-proof", event_name="", migration_copy!~".+"} |= "dynamic_calibration_event=" |= "trust starts over for calibration" |= "gravity reference: reaim)" | regexp "\"unix_ms\":(?P<unix_ms>[0-9]+)" | keep environment, machine, unix_ms | unwrap unix_ms | __error__="" [24h])) > max by (environment, machine) (max_over_time({component="depthcut", environment=~"production|alert-proof", event_name="", migration_copy!~".+"} |= "dynamic_calibration_event=" |= "trust starts over for calibration" != "gravity reference: reaim)" | regexp "\"unix_ms\":(?P<unix_ms>[0-9]+)" | keep environment, machine, unix_ms | unwrap unix_ms | __error__="" [24h])) ) or ( max by (environment, machine) (max_over_time({component="depthcut", environment=~"production|alert-proof", event_name="", migration_copy!~".+"} |= "dynamic_calibration_event=" |= "trust starts over for calibration" |= "gravity reference: reaim)" | regexp "\"unix_ms\":(?P<unix_ms>[0-9]+)" | keep environment, machine, unix_ms | unwrap unix_ms | __error__="" [24h])) unless max by (environment, machine) (max_over_time({component="depthcut", environment=~"production|alert-proof", event_name="", migration_copy!~".+"} |= "dynamic_calibration_event=" |= "trust starts over for calibration" != "gravity reference: reaim)" | regexp "\"unix_ms\":(?P<unix_ms>[0-9]+)" | keep environment, machine, unix_ms | unwrap unix_ms | __error__="" [24h])) )

annotations.description: DepthCut on {{ $labels.machine }} ({{ $labels.environment }}) repaired a moved camera with the stage-1 re-aim bridge. Play works, but the person-free recalibration (stage 2) has not replaced it yet; clips recorded meanwhile are excluded from DepthVision datasets (calibration_repair=bridge_reaim). Resolves when any non-re-aim calibration (stage 2, launcher) takes over.
annotations.summary: {{ $labels.machine }}: re-aimed calibration (bridge) active, full recalibration still due
